fact: Oran, the pilot wilaya of the national addressing reference, holds over 415,000 official unified geolocatable addresses, 406,368 numbered building entrances and 36,123 plates, and the system is to cover all 69 wilayas by 2030; 12 October 2026 report.
title: Référentiel national de l'adressage : Plus de 415 000 adresses recensées à Oran
